ayahs.text: SAY: "I seek refuge with the Sustainer of men,
ayahs.arabic: بِسْمِ ٱللَّهِ ٱلرَّحْمَٰنِ ٱلرَّحِيمِ قُلْ أَعُوذُ بِرَبِّ ٱلنَّاسِ

ayahs.text: "from the evil of the whispering, elusive tempter
"who whispers in the hearts of men
"from all [temptation to evil by] invisible forces as well as men,"
